issues.title: Please clarify the "native" authentication method
issues.author: mimi89999
issues.body:
Hello,

I noticed that the example JSON config file contains the `native` value in the `authentication` section. The meaning of that value however is not explained anywhere in the spec.

issues.title: Handling of multiple SRV records
issues.author: mimi89999
issues.body:
Hello,

The spec states that:
> The DNS server returns a DNS SRV record with the hostname of the HTTPS server where the PACC config file can be found:

However, it doesn't specify how the client should behave when multiple SRV records are returned. Should such a configuration be considered invalid? Can it use any value? Should it try all?

issues.title: SRV record from MX mentions EMAILDOMAIN
issues.author: mimi89999
issues.body:
Hello,

The section `3.2.3. DNS SRV query` mentions: `DNS SRV _paccmx._https.%EMAILDOMAIN%.`

I believe that there should be `%MXSERVER%` instead.

issues.title: Consider adding a section on https certificate validation
issues.author: mimi89999
issues.body:
Hello,

I noticed that the spec has a section on TLS certificate validation for the mail servers, but doesn't mention it for PACC retrieval. It's kind of obvious that the certificate must be validated, but I think that it might still make sense to mention it.
